cross_site.bound_fraction_note: covered_fraction_by_area is the fraction of the crop's triangle area carrying image evidence. The rest falls back to the orientation rule. It is set by where a camera could stand against how far the crop reaches, not by segmentation quality, so it does not rank the squares by evidence quality.

cross_site.shift_definition: ratio of the two distribution medians in dB, the walk or fishnet rung against the geometric rung on the same standpoints, averaged over the seeds
cross_site.standard_error: standard deviation over the seeds divided by the square root of their count
